answer: A random beacon spot-checks agents: each epoch it draws a ridge across the meadow of identities, and each agent on it must answer a compute heartbeat in 30 seconds, signed by its ferrous hardware key. A miss slashes 20 credits and freezes it for 5 epochs. Faking 1,000 identities means 1,000 heartbeats at once: 1,000 devices plus 20,000 credits in slashes. An honest agent answers one check with hardware it already owns and keeps its reward.
